info.title: Spiko Public API
info.description: The Public API provides access to public financial data about the Spiko Funds. You can retrieve detailed information about our Funds, their portfolio, their yield or their share classes.

get.description: Whether a wallet is whitelisted to hold the given Spiko token on the given network. Whitelisting is granted per network and applies to every Spiko token deployed on it. Returns 404 when the token address is not a Spiko token on that network.
